scenario: Heavy-rejection case (7 of 17 rejected outright; only 6 approved). Triggers backfill round. Demonstrates the Critic acting as a real filter — the failure mode being researched was unusual and most textbook proposals didn't engage with it.
challenge: Underperformance on a high-VIX day where the existing signal mis-ranked across cap tiers. Standard quality-momentum factors actively *hurt* on this day. Propose new candidate inputs that would have re-ranked the universe on volatility-spike days specifically.

sample_critic_catches.reasoning: Proposes a plain book-to-market value score. This is one of the most heavily-loaded inputs already in the canonical library. No incremental information.

On a vol-spike day momentum signals are precisely what the ranker over-weighted. Proposing a momentum acceleration variant doubles down on the failed direction. The mandate for this debate is to find inputs that re-rank, not reinforce.
Realised volatility over 60 days is the lagging indicator the signal already had access to. The challenge specifically asks for inputs that fire BEFORE the vol-spike day, not measure it after.
Direction is right (forward-looking vol via options) but the proposed derivation pulls from a vendor we don't currently have under licence.
sample_critic_catches.revision_guidance: Substitute the proxy: rolling 21-day correlation between VIX and SPY daily returns, z-scored over 252 days. Same regime-signal intent, computable from already-licensed data.

sample_critic_catches.reasoning: Cross-sectional return dispersion relative to index vol is exactly the kind of input that re-ranks on vol-spike days. Computation is point-in-time clean.

final_slate_sample.rationale: Defensive-quality stocks underperform in normal regimes but lead on vol-spike days. The ranker had no low-beta proxy.
Orthogonal to dominant momentum/quality drivers; captures macro break-even mispricings.
final_slate_sample.derivation: subtraction of 252-day macro break-even z-score from a residual-skew measure

final_slate_sample.rationale: Cross-sectional dispersion relative to index vol re-ranks on vol-spike days.
final_slate_sample.derivation: ratio of 21-day cross-sectional return dispersion to VIX

final_slate_sample.rationale: Balance-sheet carry isolates firms that have positive net cash relative to debt service.
Institutional ownership *changes* (not levels) precede vol-regime shifts.
final_slate_sample.derivation: 5-day pct-change of aggregated institutional holdings, lagged 1 filing day
